# HNavas Systems | Custom Software, AWS Cloud & AI Development

> Denver-based engineering consultancy founded by Diego Navas Murcia. Specializing in production full-stack web applications, serverless AWS cloud architecture, and custom AI automation pipelines for startups and established businesses across Colorado and nationwide. Bilingual (English / Spanish).

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Custom Full-Stack & SaaS Development**: End-to-end web apps, MVPs, real-time platforms, and internal tools using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, and FastAPI.
- **AWS Serverless Architecture**: Production cloud systems with 60+ Lambda functions, 40+ DynamoDB tables, API Gateway, CloudFront, Cognito, and Amazon SES.
- **AI Automation & Agents**: Custom AI pipelines, RAG systems, lead nurture bots, and email automation powered by Claude (Anthropic API) and GPT-4o (OpenAI API).
- **High-Performance Websites & Core Web Vitals**: Modern, lightning-fast sites tuned for sub-second load times and high checkout conversion.
- **Field & Mobile Ops Apps**: Custom React Native / Expo apps and rapid low-code solutions (AppSheet, Base44) with automated reporting.
- **Payments & CRM Integrations**: End-to-end integrations with Stripe, Square, Salesforce, and automated billing.

## Key Case Studies in Production

- [ScoreFlow](https://myscoreflow.com): Real-time dance competition judging SaaS built on Next.js 16, FastAPI, AWS CDK, WebSockets, and DynamoDB.
- [Dynamic Bachata Platform](https://dynamicbachata.com): Full business platform with online bookings, Square payments ($51K+ processed), and 60+ serverless endpoints.
- [Bachata Sky Weekender](https://sky.dynamicbachata.com): High-converting event ticket platform with Stripe checkout (~45% conversion).
- [Email Campaign Manager](https://emails.dynamicbachata.com): AI-driven marketing automation platform built on React, AWS Lambda, and OpenRouter.
- [Luxury Rides Denver](https://luxuryridesdenver.com): Luxury chauffeur and DIA airport car service platform.
